chapter: Life in New Orleans and tunings
title: Christmas and New Year's parties; why he moved to New Orleans
summary: Country parties at holidays and little pay, which is why he came to the city to earn money.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Did you ever go out in the Delta? Mississippi Delta? Never been up to home? Yeah. What did you do at Christmas? Out in Tallertown, Pecky and Rogueless. Did they have any parties or anything?
Any music at those parties? No. What about New Year's Eve? Did they have music at New Year's Eve on? No, they have. Not too much. What kind of music would they have?
Any kind of new thing or...

Would you get an iron? Would they pay you? No, you're sure. For New Year's Eve? Yeah. What about birthdays? It's seven hours. You don't have a telephone, but they have a telephone downstairs. Yeah. Okay. I see. We asked you about those trump piano players. Did you know any of them? Their names? Do you know any of them? Yeah. God, you play blues.
Walker, why did you decide to come to New Orleans? To live here.
For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me.

You mean to pay for it? Right. To pay for it. Right. So you didn't ever make too much out in the country playing? No. They give you something. It's just not very much. Right. Oh yeah, because I did that the man who took grave, he said that he wasn't home, he couldn't tell you.
